title: [Mechanism of Magnoliae Officinalis Cortex in treatment of peptic ulcer based on network pharmacology and molecular docking].
authors: Yang, Jue; Luo, Xiao; Liu, Fang; Lin, Lu-Jie; Gao, Yuan; Zhou, Qi
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究厚朴治疗消化性溃疡的机制，虽涉及分子对接但对象为药物成分与蛋白靶点，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法创新，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Magnoliae Officinalis Cortex(Houpo) can treat peptic ulcer disease(PUD), the mechanism of which remains unclear. In this study, network pharmacology and molecular docking were employed to predict the mechanism of Houpo in the treatment of PUD. Through literature review and TCMSP screening, 15 main active ingredients were obtained. The SwissTargetPrediction database was used to predict the potential targets of the ingredients, and Therapeutic Target Database(TTD), DrugBank, and Human Phenotype Ontology(HPO) to screen the disease-related targets. A total of 49 potential targets were obtained by the intersection of active ingre-dients-related targets and disease-related targets. Cytoscape 3.6.1 was employed to construct the protein-protein interaction network for the targets with high confidence(score>0.700) screened out by STRING. The DAVID database was used for GO and KEGG pathway enrichment of potential targets. GO enrichment analysis showed that the treatment mechanism was mostly related to nuclear receptor activity, ligand-activated transcription factor activity, and G protein-coupled acetylcholine receptor activity. KEGG enrichment analysis found that Houpo could regulate material metabolism, endocrine system, p53 signaling pathway, and PPAR signaling pathway. Molecu-lar docking verified that all 15 ingredients had good binding activities with key targets(CHRM1, CHRM2, FABP1, mTOR, and STAT3). The results mean that Houpo can treat PUD by participating in cell metabolism, inhibiting inflammatory cytokines, and regulating cell proliferation and apoptosis.
abstract_zh: 厚朴（Magnoliae Officinalis Cortex, Houpo）可治疗消化性溃疡病（peptic ulcer disease, PUD），但其机制尚不清楚。本研究采用网络药理学和分子对接（molecular docking）预测厚朴治疗PUD的机制。通过文献回顾和TCMSP筛选，获得15种主要活性成分。利用SwissTargetPrediction数据库预测成分的潜在靶点，并通过治疗靶点数据库（Therapeutic Target Database, TTD）、DrugBank和人类表型本体论（Human Phenotype Ontology, HPO）筛选疾病相关靶点。通过活性成分相关靶点与疾病相关靶点的交集，共获得49个潜在靶点。使用Cytoscape 3.6.1构建由STRING筛选出的高置信度（score>0.700）靶点的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络。利用DAVID数据库对潜在靶点进行GO和KEGG通路富集分析。GO富集分析显示，治疗机制多与核受体活性、配体激活的转录因子活性及G蛋白偶联乙酰胆碱受体活性相关。KEGG富集分析发现，厚朴可调节物质代谢、内分泌系统、p53信号通路和PPAR信号通路。分子对接验证了所有15种成分与关键靶点（CHRM1、CHRM2、FABP1、mTOR和STAT3）具有良好的结合活性。结果表明，厚朴可通过参与细胞代谢、抑制炎症细胞因子及调节细胞增殖和凋亡来治疗PUD。
